mapper.select: SELECT id,time_zone,valid_from,valid_through,peak_multiplier,off_peak_multiplier,source_url,source_version,calendar_source_url FROM nw_model_time_pricing_rules WHERE id IN ORDER BY id
SELECT rule_id,weekday FROM nw_model_time_pricing_weekdays WHERE rule_id IN ORDER BY rule_id,ordinal
SELECT rule_id,start_nanos,end_nanos FROM nw_model_time_pricing_periods WHERE rule_id IN ORDER BY rule_id,ordinal
SELECT rule_id,band,starts_on AS "from",ends_on AS through FROM nw_model_time_pricing_dates WHERE rule_id IN ORDER BY rule_id,band,ordinal
SELECT rule_id,provider_id,service_id,profile_version,model_id FROM nw_model_time_pricing_scopes WHERE rule_id IN ORDER BY rule_id,ordinal
mapper.sql: id::text,name,draft_revision AS revision,published_revision,draft_changed AS has_unpublished_changes,draft_rule_id AS rule_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_model_time_pricing_presets ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM nw_model_time_pricing_presets WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)

SELECT preset_id::text AS id,name,revision,revision AS published_revision,FALSE AS has_unpublished_changes,rule_id FROM nw_model_time_pricing_preset_versions WHERE preset_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY revision DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_model_time_pricing_presets SET name=#{name},draft_rule_id=#{rule},draft_revision=draft_revision+1,draft_changed=TRUE,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expected}

UPDATE nw_model_time_pricing_presets SET published_revision=#{revision},draft_changed=FALSE,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expected} AND draft_changed=TRUE AND (published_revision IS NULL OR published_revision=#{revision}-1)
